learning_outcomes.text: Classification of continuous-time and discrete-time signals and systems
Analysis of continuous-time and discrete-time signals and systems in the time domain
Analysis of continuous-time and discrete-time signals and systems in the frequency domain
Analysis of continuous-time and discrete-time signals and systems in the transform domain

syllabus_topics: Classification of signals and systems, basic signals
Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) systems, impulse response, convolution
Time domain analysis of LTI systems
Continuous-Time LTI Systems and Laplace Transform
Continuous-Time Fourier Transform and its Properties
Definition and analysis of LTI systems using Z-transforms
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decisions and specified in the academic calendar.
bibliography: Hwei Psu, Schaum’s Outlines on Signals and Systems, Mcgraw-Hill, 1995.
Alan Oppenheim, Alan Willsky, Signals And Systems, Prentice Hall, 1997.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
